question: What unchanged local coherent-cycle receipts does the frozen SC34 scan-family challenge produce before the selective direct-exit adjudication?

predecessor.single_change: Replace all eight consumed rows with one frozen never-consumed SC34 positive and two new SC34-to-cross-scene query pairings. Keep models, surfaces, frames after freeze, local cycle thresholds and extent gate unchanged.

reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Positive query bbox opens only after transport; negative decisions receive no exact-target query truth.

proposal.transport: Unchanged full-frame symmetric RoMa, bilateral 0.05 certainty, in-bounds target, 0.013888888888888888 round-trip error, largest 8-connected reference cycle component, ordinary affine fit and bound-extent transport.
proposal.component_tie_break: Maximum area then lowest label; no fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference and query SAM2 identity-support mask; no selection, morphology or retry.
proposal.query_extent: Transported bbox; query SAM mask is support only.

matcher.absolute_support: Frozen cycle opportunity plus dominant-component majority; global purity remains diagnostic only.

evaluation.negative_authority: A different physical 3RScan reference scan family cannot contain exact target SC34. Reused pixels carry no reused decision or target identity.

forbidden_after_freeze: change a model, surface, pair, frame, cycle, component, affine fit or local gate
use negative outcomes or positive query truth to tune the frozen 0.25 cascade threshold
reuse any FC31/FC08 prior decision or model receipt
retry, replace or remove a failed SC34 pair
claim_boundary: This inner local carrier evaluates one never-consumed physical target from a scan family not used by the coherent-cycle mechanism and two new exact-target-absent pairings with reused cross-scene query pixels. It is not the final cascade adjudication, full confirmation, provider independence, arbitrary sibling rejection, raw-camera binding, entrance, ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
